metadata.description: V2 master language registry — single source of truth.
metadata.design_principle: Only language names from extraction; all metadata from Glottolog/CLDR/Joshi.

Asháninka.joshi_rationale: Amazonian Arawakan language; not in Joshi 2020

Filipino.joshi_rationale: Filipino is standardized register of Tagalog

Ghomala'.joshi_rationale: Cameroonian Grassfields Bantu; not in Joshi 2020

Kabuverdianu.joshi_rationale: Cape Verdean Creole; not in Joshi 2020

Luo.joshi_rationale: Dholuo, Western Nilotic; not in lang2tax

Mooré.joshi_rationale: Gur language (Burkina Faso); not in lang2tax

NKo.joshi_rationale: Manding in NKo script; Bambara=1 in lang2tax

Nigerian Pidgin.joshi_rationale: Nigerian Pidgin English; not in Joshi 2020

Standard Arabic.joshi_rationale: Modern Standard Arabic → Arabic in lang2tax
